headline: Quadra Medical Services discloses substantial acquisition interest in Bandhan Bank under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Quadra Medical Services Pvt. Ltd. has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 with the NSE regarding a substantial shareholding or acquisition interest in Bandhan Bank Limited. The filing indicates a potential acquisition-related transaction, though the precise stake percentage, consideration and transaction structure remain subject to official regulatory filings.
detail: Quadra Medical Services has submitted the required disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, which mandates disclosure when an acquirer crosses prescribed thresholds (typically 25% of equity or voting rights, or control intent). The filing marks the formal public notification of the acquisition interest and triggers the statutory timeline for an open offer, subject to any applicable exemptions. The target, Bandhan Bank Limited, is a scheduled commercial bank and therefore subject to dual oversight by SEBI (takeover code) and the Reserve Bank of India (banking sector prudential norms and fit-and-proper criteria for acquirers).
